channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Robert Covington | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Robert Covington from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Kyle Lowry, Robert Covington, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“I think the next game will be finally the one. We will have Tyrese [Maxey] and KL [Kyle Lowry] back. We got Joel. We just miss RoCo [Robert Covington].… I think we are more focused on [players returning]. We are focused on how we can be the best team past [Sunday].”

Nicolas Batum on Kyle Lowry, Robert Covington, Tyrese Maxey, Apr 11, 2024. Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Nicolas Batum, Marcus Morris, Robert Covington
item.description:
L Frank on Morris/Batum/Covington:

“There will be great competition. All three are really good players. All three bring different things.”

Lawrence Frank on Nicolas Batum, Marcus Morris, Robert Covington, Sep 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins
item.description:
Michael Malone on the Blazers, Denver's opponent tomorrow:

“I think Portland's really good. Last year they were decimated by injuries. I think Terry does a really good job as their coach. One of the best backcourts in the NBA with CJ McCollum and Damian Lillard, Carmelo Anthony, Jusuf Nurkic. They've got Rodney Hood back. Zach Collins back. They get Robert Covington. They're a good basketball team. I think they're going to have a much better season in the regular season than they had last year because they're going to be healthy.”

Michael Malone on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, CJ McCollum, Robert Covington, Rodney Hood, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins, Dec 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Derrick Jones on Robert Covington
item.description:
Still, Jones delivered the line in his next meeting, with a delegation from the Portland Trail Blazers.

“If I was to come there, I believe that me and Robert Covington could help the team a whole lot,”

Derrick Jones on Robert Covington, Nov 26, 2020. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Chris Paul on Robert Covington
item.description:
Chris Paul on the Thunder’s offense in the final 7 minutes (only six points):

“That’s on me. On that last play I put Shai in a tough situation. We’d been playing with pace, seeking out Robert Covington. It’s a tough one. We had our chances.”

Chris Paul on Robert Covington, Sep 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @ErikkHorne.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Robert Covington
item.description:
Salman Ali:Mike D'Antoni on Robert Covington playing 19 mins last night:

“I probably should have brought him back [in the game].I told him that.”

Mike D'Antoni on Robert Covington, Aug 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Robert Covington
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“We do thinka second training camp benefits us because when you integrate a starter onto a very good team, getting more time to drill and rep things, especially on the defensive end, will allow us to integrate Covington in. And I do think that slightly favors us.”

Daryl Morey on Robert Covington, Jul 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Russell Westbrook, Robert Covington
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“The biggest reason for the trade was to get Covington and he's actually been even better than we thought... Not only how good he is, but how much he helps everyone on the team, but in particular Russell Westbrook. The driving lanes for him are super important.”

Daryl Morey on Russell Westbrook, Robert Covington, Mar 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Robert Covington
item.description:
Morey:

“It was really just Covington becoming available. We’ve been working on that for a long time. We thought he’d be a perfect piece to play the style we thought would be best for two superstars on our roster. Clint is an extremely good player and one we did not want to give up. But it was required in this deal. Without the perfect piece for how we wanted to play becoming available, Clint would still be here. That was really the only way to get this done.”

Daryl Morey on Robert Covington, Feb 7, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Tyus Jones on Dario Saric, Robert Covington
item.description:
Dane Moore:Tyus Jones on playing with Dario Saric and Robert Covington:

“I think it will be great. I love playing with floor spacers.”

Tyus Jones on Dario Saric, Robert Covington, Nov 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Brett Brown on Robert Covington
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Brown on Covington:

“I'm going to give him the benefit of the doubt that his time will come.”

Brett Brown on Robert Covington, Nov 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Sam Hinkie on Robert Covington
item.description:
“Many in the world would have us choose safer options -- keep this player, instead of taking a gamble on a player whose name you don't know. But when that player becomes Robert Covington, people are excited. We've chosen that sort of thing very often.”

Sam Hinkie on Robert Covington, Dec 11, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Brett Brown on Robert Covington
item.description:
Following Tuesday’s practice, Sixers head coach Brett Brown revealed thatthe sharpshooter reinjured the same right knee that held him out of the first two games of the season and that his status for Wednesday’s game at Milwaukee is uncertain.

“Covington went down today and we’re not sure what’s going to be his status,”

Brett Brown on Robert Covington, Nov 3, 2015. Source: CSNPhilly.com.
